title: Requirement written with two version components
description: go.mod declares a requirement version with no patch component. The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a requirement version with no patch component.
remediation: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix a requirement version with no patch component.
limitation: It matches a requirement version with no patch component in the parsed go.mod; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
